Hero.headline: Stablecoin Payments, Built for Business
Hero.subheading: Tempest is the non-custodial orchestration layer that makes stablecoin payments simple, trusted, and enterprise-ready, so you can accept, pay, and reconcile across any chain with confidence.
Hero.finePrint: No credit card required · Non-custodial · Enterprise SLA available

Features.label: Platform Capabilities
Features.heading: Everything your payments stack needs
Features.description: We abstract exchanges, blockchains, and wallets into a single flow so stablecoins can be onboarded, sent, and settled easily while unlocking the full power of on-chain tools.
Features.f1body: Integrated on and off-ramps allow businesses to move between traditional fiat and stablecoins without leaving the platform.
Features.f2body: Clear, immutable audit trail and robust counterparty identification to build trust between stakeholders at every step.
Features.f3body: Multi-party authorization rules maintain strict internal controls and prevent unauthorized fund movements, without sacrificing speed.
Features.f4body: Native connectivity with eBL platforms ensures that digital bills of lading and payment triggers work in perfect sync with your workflows.
Features.f5body: Programmable rules facilitate automated payment release conditional upon document receipt, milestone completion, or inspection approvals.
Features.f6body: Built-in integration layers for major ERP systems synchronize trade data with your existing financial records, with no manual re-entry.

Solutions.label: Solutions
Solutions.heading: Payment flows built for your industry
Solutions.description: Tempest lays the foundation for programmable, composable stablecoin workflows: conditional payments, automated settlement, and deep integration with financial and operational systems.
Solutions.tfDesc: Trade finance workflows are slowed down by manual checks, scattered documents, and payment risk. Tempest lets you define the rules once, and then settlement, documents, and notifications run automatically in the background.
Solutions.tfAudienceTitle: Built for every party in the trade
Solutions.tfA1body: Shorten cash cycles and make working capital predictable with rule-based settlement.
Solutions.tfA2body: Reduce operational risk and unlock new trade programs with programmable rails you can monitor in real time.
Solutions.tfA3body: Tie logistics milestones directly to release of funds, reducing disputes and delays across lanes.
Solutions.tfFeaturesHeading: What you get with Tempest Trade Finance
Solutions.tfF1body: Encode conditions like document receipt, milestone completion, or inspection approvals so funds only move when the right triggers fire.
Solutions.tfF2body: Keep invoices, B/Ls, and inspection certificates in lockstep with payment state so everyone sees the same source of truth.
Solutions.tfF3body: Connect to the systems you already use so trades show up where finance, risk, and ops teams work today.
Solutions.tfF4body: Capture approvals from buyers, sellers, banks, and inspectors in a single workflow with auditable on-chain signatures.
Solutions.tfF5body: Encode limits, sanctions lists, and exposure thresholds directly into payment logic to reduce operational and credit risk.
Solutions.tfF6body: Every rule, approval, and settlement is recorded for real-time visibility, dispute resolution, and regulatory reporting.
Solutions.tfStepsHeading: How a trade finance flow works
Solutions.tfS1desc: Ingest trade docs from your platforms or upload directly: invoices, purchase orders, B/Ls, inspections, and more.
Solutions.tfS2desc: Model when funds should move using no-code and API-based rules: dates, statuses, events, and approvals.
Solutions.tfS3desc: Tempest executes stablecoin payments as each condition is met, including partials, milestones, and final settlement.
Solutions.tfS4desc: Post back to ERP, treasury, and ledgers in real-time so reconciliations and reporting are always up to date.
Solutions.tfCtaDesc: Use Tempest to stand up automated, bank-grade trade workflows without rebuilding your stack. See a live demo of programmable settlement, documents, and controls for your lanes.
Solutions.hvDesc: Programmable payments for high-value retail: escrow, milestones, and seamless checkout. Launching soon.

CompanyPage.metaDesc: Build the financial infrastructure for how modern businesses actually operate.
CompanyPage.heroDesc: We're building the financial infrastructure that lets businesses send, receive, and program payments globally, without the friction of the traditional system.
CompanyPage.missionHeading: The global financial system is slow, expensive, and disconnected from the way modern businesses actually operate.
CompanyPage.missionP1: Cross-border payments still take days. Businesses pay 1–4% in fees per transaction. Money can't respond to business logic, and every payment requires manual coordination. Nothing is synchronized with the underlying trade or contract.
CompanyPage.missionP2: We believe that's a solvable problem. Stablecoins and programmable payment infrastructure make it possible to settle in seconds, cut costs to near zero, and tie money movement directly to business events, automatically.
CompanyPage.missionP3: Tempest is the orchestration layer that makes this real for businesses. Not a crypto product, but a payments product built on better rails.
CompanyPage.problemHeading: Four things broken about how money moves today.
CompanyPage.p1body: Cross-border transactions move through multiple intermediaries with little visibility. What should take seconds takes days.
CompanyPage.p2body: FX spreads, wire fees, and reconciliation overhead compound to 1–4% per transaction, a significant tax on every business that operates globally.
CompanyPage.p3body: Money doesn't respond to business logic. Every conditional payment, escrow, or milestone release requires manual intervention.
CompanyPage.p4body: In trade finance, payments and ownership documents like Bills of Lading are completely out of sync, creating risk, disputes, and delays.
CompanyPage.teamHeading: Built by people who've seen the problem up close.
CompanyPage.teamDesc: We came from institutions where slow, fragmented payment rails created real friction every day. We left to fix it.
CompanyPage.davidBio: Quantitative analyst at Bloomberg who built models on US Bill of Lading and customs data to analyze global trade flows, shipping risk, and capital impact, turning real-world cargo movement into financial insight.
CompanyPage.brianBio: Software engineer with 3 years at Google building scalable cloud infrastructure, specializing in third-party developer platforms and distributed systems.
CompanyPage.advisoryBoardDesc: Senior operators and investors who shape our strategy and open doors.
CompanyPage.tonyBio: Previously Managing Director at Blackstone with deep expertise in private equity, cross-border capital markets, and high-value asset transactions. Tony advises Tempest on enterprise go-to-market strategy and institutional partnerships.
CompanyPage.partnersHeading: Built with the best infrastructure in the space.
CompanyPage.partnersDesc: We partner with category-defining companies to deliver a complete, reliable stack: stablecoin rails, identity, custody, and trade documents.
CompanyPage.bridgeDesc: Stablecoin issuance & on/off-ramp rails · a Stripe company
CompanyPage.ctaDesc: Whether you're exploring stablecoin payments, building a trade finance workflow, or just want to learn more, we would love to hear from you.

TradeFinancePage.metaDesc: Close the trust gap on every cross-border trade. Conditional escrow, trade financing, and invoice factoring on fast, low-cost rails — so importers and exporters trade with confidence.
TradeFinancePage.heroHeadline: The trust gap follows every trade.
TradeFinancePage.heroDesc: It blocks deals with new partners outright, and rides on every existing shipment. Tempest closes that gap — with conditional escrow, trade financing, and invoice factoring.
TradeFinancePage.calcHeading: What does a cross-border deal really cost you?
TradeFinancePage.calcDesc: Banks, LCs, FX spreads, and weeks of tied-up cash quietly eat your margin. Enter your deal to see the all-in cost the old way — and what Tempest's on-chain settlement saves.
TradeFinancePage.faq1a: Tempest is a non-custodial stablecoin orchestration layer for B2B payments and trade finance. It lets businesses accept, pay, and reconcile payments across any blockchain, with programmable settlement that releases funds automatically when trade conditions — like a bill of lading, inspection, or milestone — are verified.
TradeFinancePage.faq2q: How does Tempest protect a supplier prepayment?
TradeFinancePage.faq2a: Payments sit in non-custodial escrow and only release when the agreed proof lands — a bill of lading, an inspection certificate, or a delivery confirmation. The buyer keeps control of funds until conditions are met; the supplier gets certainty the money is real.
TradeFinancePage.faq3a: No. Tempest is a payments product built on stablecoin rails. Transactions settle in US dollars, in seconds, and the platform abstracts away exchanges, wallets, and blockchains so businesses never have to manage crypto directly.
TradeFinancePage.faq4q: How is Tempest different from a letter of credit?
TradeFinancePage.faq4a: A letter of credit is slow, bank-intermediated, and expensive. Tempest provides programmable, non-custodial escrow that releases payment automatically against verified trade documents — settling in seconds at near-zero cost, without a bank in the middle.
TradeFinancePage.problemHeading: The same friction shows up in every deal.
TradeFinancePage.p1Title: Making the first move is a real risk.
TradeFinancePage.p1Body: With a new partner, the standoff can stop a deal from happening at all. With one you've trusted for years, the residual risk still rides on every shipment.
TradeFinancePage.standoffImporter: I won't pay until the goods arrive.
TradeFinancePage.standoffExporter: I won't ship until the money's in.
TradeFinancePage.p2Title: Your capital is stuck in transit.
TradeFinancePage.p2Body: Long payment cycles lock cash inside deals already in motion — the money you need to grow the next one.
TradeFinancePage.timelineNote: Working capital locked the whole time
TradeFinancePage.p3Title: The financing doesn't reach who needs it.
TradeFinancePage.p3Body: Even when a deal is sound, the support to fund it often isn't there.
TradeFinancePage.p3aBody: Traditional lenders won't extend affordable financing to many of the importers who need working capital most.
TradeFinancePage.p3bBody: In many corridors, correspondent banking is underdeveloped — payments are slow and expensive before a deal even closes.
TradeFinancePage.solutionHeading: The tools to trade through all of it.
TradeFinancePage.sol1Body: Payment releases only when the terms are met.
TradeFinancePage.sol2Body: Flexible terms and competitive rates for importers.
TradeFinancePage.sol3Body: Exporters get paid immediately and offload risk.
TradeFinancePage.escrowHeading: Money that releases only when terms are met.
TradeFinancePage.escrowDesc: Importers don't pay into the dark. Exporters know the money is real and waiting.
TradeFinancePage.ffHeading: Free up the cash trapped in every deal.
TradeFinancePage.ffE1: Get paid the day you ship
TradeFinancePage.ffNote: Settlement runs on stablecoin rails underneath — fast and low-cost, even where banks underserve.

TradeCalculator.intro: Pick your side of the trade and the tool you'd use today. We'll show the all-in cost, the working capital it frees, and whether it covers counterparty risk — against Tempest.
TradeCalculator.termHint: Agreed days until payment is due.
TradeCalculator.restructureHint: Counts term compression from moving off net-term to release-on-shipment.
TradeCalculator.riskAdjustedHint: Adds expected loss to options that don't cover counterparty risk.
TradeCalculator.wcNoteDefault: Counts only the settlement / clearing lag escrow removes. Turn on “release on shipment” to include term compression.
TradeCalculator.wcNoteFactor: Factoring advances cash sooner — here Tempest wins on fees and keeping full invoice value, not speed.
TradeCalculator.wcNoteRestructure: Includes term compression from releasing on shipment instead of net-term.
TradeCalculator.riskNote: Escrow holds funds and releases only on verified proof — payment certainty without a bank.
